Exporter shall be able to link digitally uploaded annexure with the online applications under various schemes of the FTP. (g) 24 X 7 Helpdesk Facility to guide applicants and monitor grievances A dedicated 24 X 7 Helpdesk facility has been put in place to assist the exporters in filing online applications on the DGFT portal and other matters pertaining to Foreign Trade Policy. A Help manual & FAQs for filing various applications under the FTP are also available on DGFT website under the link https://dgft.gov.in> Learn > Application Help & FAQs. For assistance any of the following channels may be accessed — (i) Raise a service request ticket on DGFT website under the link > Services > DGFT Helpdesk Service (ii) Call the DGFT toll free helpline number at 1800-572-1550 / 1800-111-550 (iii)
